title: Sentinel-2 Natural Color
description:
Three-band natural colour composite from Sentinel-2, combining the red, green and blue MSI bands into a view approximating what the human eye would see. Produced for disaster activations from Sentinel-2A, 2B and 2C acquisitions and staged as 8-bit RGB COGs at 10 m resolution.

Covers several activations: the February 2023 Turkiye earthquake, Hurricane Idalia (pre-event baseline, July 2023), Tropical Storm Debby (August 2024) and the February 2025 Ohio Valley flood. Scene naming varies across activations because the composites were produced by different runs; the discovery regex accepts every variant.
